en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play dodgeball
I'll just watch you...
Let's burn this place to the ground

Yaaaay! I was just thinking about
playing dodgeball with you, Shuichi!

That way, I can take out all my pent-up
anger on you in a perfectly healthy way!
<CLT=cltMIND>...
So you're just gonna watch me exercise?
Um...but why?

If this is a joke, then it's a bad one.
Don't ever say it again, okay?

Does this mean you're ready to do evil with me!?
You really wanna join my organization!?

Then, you're more than welcome!
You'll be my right-hand man!
Huh? That was a lie?

No way...that's so mean!
Deceit is the most sinful act in the world!

WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!

Shuichi tricked meeeeEEEEeeee
EEEEEEeeeeeeEEEEEEeeeeee!!!

By the way, the crying's all fake.
But I really do feel betrayed.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
